# Reverend Ez

## Overview

- **Gender:** male  <sub>[v3 c24 P20](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0020)</sub>
- **Role:** Clergyman / Minister  <sub>[v3 c24 P10](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0010), [v3 c24 P14](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0014)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Ez  <sub>[v3 c24 P11](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0011)</sub>; Ezra  <sub>[v3 c24 P9](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0009)</sub>

## Appearance

He is an extremely plain young man with a large, gangly frame and long legs. He has limp, flaxen hair, green eyes, a large mouth, and prominent ears.

_Sources: [v3 c24 P10](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0010)_

## Personality

He has a charming voice, a deep and beautiful soul, and a passionate, serious commitment to his calling. He enjoys laughing and making jokes, though he takes his work as a minister earnestly.

_Sources: [v3 c24 P11](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0011), [v3 c24 P12](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0012), [v3 c25 P2](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0002)_

## Traits

- Plain-looking  <sub>[v3 c24 P10](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0010)</sub>
- Serious about his religious calling  <sub>[v3 c24 P14](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0014), [v3 c25 P2](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0002)</sub>
- Playful and jovial  <sub>[v3 c25 P2](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0002)</sub>

## Abilities

- Preaching and public speaking  <sub>[v3 c24 P11](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0011), [v3 c24 P14](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0014)</sub>

## Goals

- Serve in the ministry and do his duty with God's help  <sub>[v3 c24 P19](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0019)</sub>

## History

Ezra Hale studied theology at St. Columbia and spent a summer managing the Point Prospect Mission Church, where he met Cressida Lindsay. After completing his studies, he took on a mission church in the Tanner Street slums. Despite his plain appearance, he won Cressida's heart and eventually proposed to her. They were married the following June in her home garden and later attended Nell Harcourt's wedding at Grey Shutters, where Ez offered a memorable wedding prayer.

_Sources: [v3 c24 P9](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0009), [v3 c27 P29](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0029), [v4 c3 P9](../source/v04-c03.md#nw-v04-c03-p0009), [v4 c4 P15](../source/v04-c04.md#nw-v04-c04-p0015)_

## Background by volume

- Studied theology at St. Columbia  <sub>[v3 c24 P9](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0009)</sub>
- Took charge of the Point Prospect Mission Church during his student summer  <sub>[v3 c24 P9](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0009)</sub>
- Assumed charge of a small mission church in the Tanner Street slums after finishing his studies

## Quotes

> I attempted to be a different person for a extended period—I lacked the desire to be a clergyman. However, I eventually realized that it was the labor assigned to me—and with the assistance of God, I will endeavor to fulfill it.  <sub>[v3 c24 P19](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0019)</sub>


## Affiliations

- Point Prospect Mission Church — Summer Minister  <sub>[v3 c24 P9](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0009)</sub>
- Tanner Street Mission Church — Minister

## Relationships

### Cressida Lindsay

- Spouse of — Courtively pursued and eventually married her.  <sub>[v3 c27 P29](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0029), [v4 c3 P9](../source/v04-c03.md#nw-v04-c03-p0009)</sub>
